verdict.rationale: The SDK has a dedicated streaming-output guide where setting `include_partial_messages`/`includePartialMessages` enables token-level partial messages. `query()` is an async iterator yielding typed messages such as AssistantMessage, which lets a UI consume agent output as it arrives. Hooks also fire on agent events like tool calls and session start/stop, giving further real-time event surfacing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the streamed event types for tool calls and steps (e.g. tool_use/tool_result message shapes), and independent hands-on corroboration of real-time UI streaming.
